info.author: Sandbox
info.description: Graph-driven Clean Flower Child using pitch-domain Ranges + pitchHz converters. masterPitch −120…105 → clock Hz; LPF1 pitch 90…180; LPF2 pitch 80…130 (FCF pitch law).
info.name: FCF Clean breadboard

morph.tooltip: 0…1 width/duty. 0.5 = center / 50%. Trisaw, Pulse, and Center Square (pulse grows from mid-cycle — not a stepped square). Morph MOD jack on the param row.

motion.tooltip: Ph = running phasor. T = simulation time. Clock vs CounterClock flips direction.

frequency.tooltip: Rate in Hz. Slider 0…5000 Hz. Negative values reverse.

morph.tooltip: 0…1 width/duty. Square = leading-edge PWM. Trisaw = triangle warp. Center Square = pulse width growing left/right from mid-cycle.

resonance.tooltip: Rate in Hz. Slider 0…5000 Hz. Negative values reverse.

amplitude.tooltip: Scale and invert. 0 = mute, +1 = unity, −1 = invert. Bipolar rational is finer around 0.

volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

smoothingSeconds.tooltip: Time the output takes to reach the mouse target. 0 = snap.

smoothingType.tooltip: Lin = constant-time ramp. 1P / 2P = exponential. Papoulis = 3rd-order settle.

displaySource.tooltip: Mouse = target the pointer set. Smoothed = actual output chasing that target.

polarity.tooltip: Legacy. Bipolar with Min at 0 maps Bias to −Max…+Max.

inLow.tooltip: Input value that maps to Out Low. Default −1 (bipolar). Wire unipolar spawn uses 0…1.

inHigh.tooltip: Input value that maps to Out High. Default +1 (bipolar).

outLow.tooltip: Output at In Low. Module default −10 (bipolar). Wire spawn uses −1 or 0 for unit CV.

outHigh.tooltip: Output at In High. Module default +10 (bipolar). Wire spawn uses +1 for unit CV; unipolar param default is 0…10.
